subject: Re: Playbook & MAP for exchanging evaluation datasets and prompt pack (Acme)
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Playbook & MAP for dataset/promptpack exchange

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme is excited to run a short evaluation using Redwood’s runtime for a targeted retail QA workflow. To move quickly, we'd like to exchange an evaluation dataset (3k anonymized chat logs) plus our internal prompt-pack and a small set of labeled test cases.

High-level asks from our side:
- A mutually agreed MAP that outlines milestones, owners, and acceptance gates (we expect a 2-week hands-on eval).
- Ephemeral access only — dataset must not be used for model training or shared outside the eval pods.
- Proof of access controls and audit logs for token-level usage.

Can you propose a playbook and timeline today? Priya (cc) will coordinate the data packaging on our end.

Jordan
Head of ML, Acme AI

Attachment: Acme-eval-data-summary.xlsx (metadata only)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acme.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook & MAP for dataset/promptpack exchange

Jordan — thanks, excited to run this with you. Draft MAP and playbook below (quick version so we can lock timelines). I attached our standard NDA template to speed legal (NDA_Acme-Redwood-signed.pdf) — happy to accept your counters.

Proposed MAP (two-week runway):
1) Legal & Access (Day 0–2) — NDA executed, Data Processing Addendum agreed. Owner: Ben / Acme Legal.
2) Packaging & Transfer (Day 2–4) — Acme packages: eval-dataset (3k anonymized rows), prompt-pack v2 (zipped), testcases_manifest.csv. Transfer via pre-signed S3 URL or secure Drive link. Owner: Priya / Marissa.
3) Provisioning & Hardening (Day 4–6) — Redwood provisions ephemeral evaluation pod with RBAC, VPC egress controls (if needed), and KV/prefix caching enabled. Owner: Karthik.
4) Execution & Monitoring (Day 6–12) — Run 48-hour acceptance pass, capture token-level cost, latency, and per-prompt quality metrics. Owner: Acme/Redwood engineers. Acceptance gate: F1 >= 0.72 on labeled testcases OR agreed qualitative review.
5) Review & Close (Day 13–14) — Results review call, feedback log, and decision to proceed to pilot. Owner: Ben / Jordan.

Key usage constraints (non-negotiable from Redwood):
- Data may only be used within the ephemeral evaluation pods; no training, fine-tuning, or retention beyond the agreed window.
- Redwood will delete cached prefixes and KV after 30 days; Acme must confirm deletion schedule for any local copies.
- Outputs that contain customer PII must be redacted; both parties will work from the testcases_manifest to flag sensitive buckets.
- Redistribution: prompt-pack cannot be shared outside of Acme/Redwood evaluation owners.

Next steps I suggest:
- Ben/Acme legal sign NDA today (attached).
- Priya upload artifacts to the shared folder and ping Marissa when done.
- Karthik will send the provisioning checklist + S3 presign details.

I’ll schedule the kickoff for Day 3 (we’re flexible).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: NDA_Acme-Redwood-signed.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Playbook & MAP for dataset/promptpack exchange

Priya — quick technical notes so the handoff is clean.

Packaging checklist (Acme deliverable):
- eval_dataset.csv (CSV, rows anonymized, columns: session_id, turn_index, user_text, assistant_text, label)
- promptpack-v2.zip (README + 8 prompt templates)
- testcases_manifest.csv (id, input, expected_output, metric, sensitivity_flag)

Provisioning details (Redwood deliverable):
- We will create an ephemeral project-scoped pod in us-west-2 with limited outbound network egress.
- Access: single-service account for Acme engineers (scoped IAM creds), IP allowlist option available.
- Audit logs: we will provide usage logs (token counts per request) and a week-long access audit export (CSV).

Data constraints & verification:
- We require a signed attestation that the dataset is deidentified to our SOC2 standards before provisioning.
- If any record is flagged by our sensitivity scanner during ingestion, it will be quarantined and we will notify Acme immediately.

Operational notes:
- For the evaluation, we will enable prefix caching but persist caches only to the evaluation pod; explicit deletion scheduled Day 30 post-close.
- If Acme wants shorter retention, state it in reply and we can reduce to Day 7.

I’ll open the provisioning checklist and S3 presign within 24 hours once we see the upload link.

—Karthik
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800

Thanks — Ben/Karthik. We reviewed the MAP and the constraints and can accept with two small redlines:
1) Retention: set cache deletion to Day 7 instead of Day 30 (we want minimal surface).
2) Audit export: request delivery of a signed audit manifest (hash-signed) after the acceptance pass.

We uploaded artifacts to the shared folder: drive link in the Hub doc. Files included: eval_dataset.csv (sampled 3k rows), promptpack-v2.zip, testcases_manifest.csv.

NDA signed and attached (NDA_Acme-Redwood-signed.pdf). We will not permit the dataset to be used for training; we will also accept the sensitivity scanner quarantine flow.

Can Karthik confirm Day 3 provisioning start if we got the link today?

—Priya
Data & Evaluation Lead, Acme AI

Best,
Ben Carter
